flags.why: The linking action expressed by xâu chuỗi has been incorrectly presented as the noun meaning 'a series of events'.
In this usage, dịch tễ concerns epidemiology rather than naming a disease outbreak ([medical reference](https://bsgdtphcm.vn/api/fullcontent.php?id=15173)).
flags.fix: epidemiology; patterns of disease occurrence and spread

flags.why: Tình hình dịch tễ means the epidemiological situation, which the translation incorrectly narrows to an epidemic ([medical reference](https://bsgdtphcm.vn/api/fullcontent.php?id=15173)).
flags.fix: The Ministry of Health is monitoring the epidemiological situation in the provinces.
